name: Tenkasi
intro: Shafts, flats and nylon parts for the power looms of Kadayanallur and Sankarankovil, and angles for the builders around Tenkasi, on our Rajapalayam-route truck next day.

name: Ramanathapuram
intro: Stainless 316 shafting and gunmetal bushes for the boats of Mandapam and Keelakarai, and sections for the builders of Ramanathapuram and Paramakudi, delivered next day.

name: Sivaganga
intro: Under an hour east of Madurai: square bars, angles and chequered plate for the gate, grill and farm-implement workshops of Sivaganga, Manamadurai and Tiruppuvanam, delivered the same day.
